description: This file contains Makefile definitions and shell script snippets for building and managing root filesystem images, including conditional compilation for MKLIBS, package management commands (opkg, apk), and root filesystem preparation routines.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Defines a shell script routine to find, process, and copy dynamically linked libraries and programs for building a minimal set of libraries.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines a command template for the opkg package manager with specific options for offline root and package handling.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: Defines a command template for the apk package manager with specific options for root and key management.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Defines a routine to clean up opkg package info and status files, removing unnecessary files and resetting package status.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Defines a routine to prepare the root filesystem, including copying files, running post-install scripts, enabling/disabling init scripts, cleaning up version control directories, and invoking other routines for cleanup and library processing.
